exact_delivery_contract.why_existing_source_cannot_close: No accepted source frame has this exact state/facing and hand/weapon contract. exact_delivery_contract.weapon_contract: Preserve established authored equipment/props for this entity; no interchangeable proxy.
exact_delivery_contract.source_scale: Deliver at requested canvas dimensions with uniform scale and complete source silhouette; no stretch or invented covered pixels.
exact_delivery_contract.allowed_baked_vfx: Permanent canonical markings/glow only; any source-baked temporal effect requires explicit state restriction and provenance.
exact_delivery_contract.separate_vfx: Trails, charge, impact, damage flash, status, reward burst and floor/contact particles remain separate runtime layers.
exact_delivery_contract.integration_contract: Sidecar declares exact state/view/family, actual primary/secondary palms, Core, ground, foreground fingers, and baked equipment. Register approved delivery in the existing per-state manifest; never route another state implicitly. Compatible identical bodies may share a single PNG only after family socket validation.

occupied_bounds.rule: Full silhouette inside these bounds; match per-ID proportions and existing ground target, not a stretched square.

exact_delivery_contract.visible_anatomy: Complete head/ears, torso/hips, source-authored limbs, feet/tail and relevant hands; palms/grips must not be obscured by charge, trails, sheet text or another pose. Do not reconstruct covered anatomy.
exact_delivery_contract.required_pose: Exact named POUNCE windup state of this established entity; follow its existing route/attack clocks without redesign.
separate_layers_required: named attack VFX and launch points separate from canonical body
activity props with actual hand/contact metadata where required
